title: Reinforcement Learning Unlearns Corrupted SFT Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2611.26756v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We show that reinforcement learning (RL) in reasoning tasks can succeed even when the supervised fine-tuning (SFT) data is severely corrupted. In a mathematical reasoning dataset (GSM8K), we systematically corrupt training trajectories across 361 configurations by injecting realistic error types, varying error locations, trace-answer consistency, and corruption ratios up to 100%. While aggregated SFT-only performance steadily deteriorates under corruption (dropping from 43.61% to 13.80%), Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) post-training consistently restores model accuracy back to gold-baseline levels (approximately 60%). Crucially, initializing RL with as few as N = 8 minimal, incorrect, three-line "form-only" traces boosts post-RL performance to 69.30%, outperforming standard gold SFT initialization (60.71%) and GRPO without SFT (35.00%). translated_title: 强化学习能够“遗忘”受损的SFT推理
translated_abstract: 我们证明，即使监督微调（SFT）数据严重受损，推理任务中的强化学习（RL）仍然可以取得成功。在数学推理数据集GSM8K上，我们通过注入真实的错误类型，在361种配置中系统性地破坏训练轨迹，改变因素包括错误位置、轨迹与答案的一致性以及高达100%的损坏比例。虽然在数据损坏情况下仅使用SFT的性能持续恶化（从43.61%降至13.80%），但群体相对策略优化（GRPO）后训练能够持续将模型准确率恢复到黄金基线水平（约60%）。至关重要的是，仅用N=8条最小化的、错误的、三行的“仅形式”轨迹来初始化RL，就能将RL后训练性能提升至69.30%，优于标准黄金SFT初始化（60.71%）和无SFT的GRPO（35.00%）。此外，我们发现SFT准确率与RL后训练准确率基本不相关（r approxi
tldr: 强化学习后训练（GRPO）能够恢复被严重损坏的SFT数据造成的性能下降，仅用8条错误的“仅形式”轨迹初始化RL甚至可以超越黄金SFT初始化的表现，且SFT准确率与RL后准确率基本不相关。
en_tdlr: RL post-training with GRPO can fully recover from severely corrupted SFT data—initializing with just 8 minimal, incorrect "form-only" traces outperforms gold SFT initialization, and SFT accuracy is largely uncorrelated with post-RL accuracy.
